projects.title: OBE Evaluation System (Outcome Based Education)
projects.description: Accreditation & outcome-based education platform built at DYPCOE&I Incubation Centre for faculty and principals to automate CO-PO mapping and attainment calculations required by NBA and NAAC.
projects.longDescription: Selected as Full stack engineer to build, at the DYPCOE&I Incubation Centre, an Outcome Based Education (OBE) system that faculty, Heads of Departments (HODs), and the principal use for CO-PO mapping and attainment calculation, as mandated by NBA and NAAC accreditation standards. Automates complex direct and indirect attainment formulas, course outcome assessments, and department-wide accreditation reporting.
features: Automated Course Outcome (CO) and Program Outcome (PO) mapping matrix
Direct and indirect attainment calculation algorithms aligned with NBA and NAAC criteria
Role-based access control (RBAC) dashboards for Faculty, HODs, and Principal
Institutional analytics and accreditation report generation
Course attainment tracking across semesters and academic batches

projects.title: Aahaar ai
projects.description: AI-powered nutrition and personalized meal planning platform tailored for regional dietary habits, macronutrient optimization, and smart health tracking.
projects.longDescription: Aahaar AI is an intelligent health-tech platform engineered to revolutionize dietary wellness. Built around modern LLM intelligence and nutritional data science, it generates personalized meal plans tailored to regional Indian diets, calculates accurate real-time macro breakdowns, and provides proactive conversational guidance for fitness, clinical dietary needs, and lifestyle improvement.
features: AI-driven meal planning engine respecting regional cultural diets and dietary restrictions
Interactive dietary chatbot powered by Grok & Claude APIs
Dynamic calorie and macro-nutrient balance calculator with visual progress metrics
Personalized nutritional recommendation pipelines for fitness and clinical goals

projects.title: KrishiRakshak
projects.description: AI-driven Agri-Tech platform offering real-time crop disease diagnosis, localized pest surveillance alerts, and predictive farming advisory for farmers.
projects.longDescription: KrishiRakshak is an Agri-Tech platform built to empower Indian farmers with intelligent crop diagnostics. Leveraging computer vision models and real-time agricultural APIs, the system identifies plant diseases from mobile leaf photos, offers verified organic and chemical treatments, and issues localized alerts for weather extremes and pest outbreaks in regional languages.
features: Computer vision image diagnosis for plant disease detection and leaf pathology
Vernacular audio and text advisory tailored for accessibility by local farmers
Proactive pest forecast radar and localized weather warnings
Accurate fertilizer and treatment dosage recommendations with cost estimates

projects.title: VasuNiti - IT company
projects.description: Enterprise digital presence and client solutions platform for VasuNiti, delivering modern web applications, scalable digital products, and IT consulting.
projects.longDescription: VasuNiti is an IT and software solutions company delivering cutting-edge digital experiences and enterprise architectures. The platform serves as the central hub for showcasing services, case studies, automated client scoping, and digital delivery pipelines, built with modern web technologies, responsive dark aesthetics, and optimized cloud deployments.
features: High-performance corporate agency portal with kinetic UI interactions
Interactive service discovery, project cost scoping, and client inquiry pipeline
Showcase of full-stack MERN architectures and cloud integration capabilities
Optimized SEO, responsive design system, and fast load benchmarks

projects.title: MyFin AI – AI Finance Controller
projects.description: Specification-driven finance controller that automates high-throughput payment reconciliation across multi-source financial chains with AI exception investigation.
projects.longDescription: Built for the Razorpay Buildathon, MyFin AI is a specification-driven financial controller that automates high-throughput payment reconciliation across multi-source financial chains. Features AI-driven exception and dispute investigation, automated audit logs, and real-time transaction health metrics.
features: Specification-driven automated high-throughput payment reconciliation
Multi-source financial chain integration with Razorpay APIs
AI-driven exception and dispute investigation with automated audit logs
Executive financial dashboard with failure analytics and real-time reconciliation health
Instant root-cause analysis for failed and mismatched transactions

projects.title: Shiksha Netra – School Management System (SaaS)
projects.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for student records, teacher data, fee management, and automated Leaving Certificate & Bonafide letter generation.
projects.longDescription: Developed a multi-tenant platform for student records, teacher data and fee management. Automates Leaving Certificate (LC) and Bonafide letter generation, drastically cutting manual administrative paperwork for school staff. Deployed live with responsive portals.
features: Multi-tenant architecture managing student profiles, classes, and teachers
Automated one-click Leaving Certificate (LC) and Bonafide letter generation
Fee structure management, payment status tracking, and receipt generation
Role-based access for school administrators, clerks, and teachers
Live deployment on Netlify: shikshanetra.netlify.app

projects.title: Fitpulse – Gym Management System (SaaS)
projects.description: SaaS gym system featuring member portals, reusable workout/diet templates, client-side nutrition calculator, and a Grok-powered AI chatbot.
projects.longDescription: Built member records, memberships and a member portal with trainer-assigned workout and diet plans using a reusable template pattern. Features client-side nutrition calculator with goal-based diet template matching and an integrated AI chatbot powered by Grok API for instant guidance.
features: Member records, membership tier tracking, and member self-service portal
Trainer-assigned workout and diet plans using reusable template patterns
Client-side nutrition calculator with goal-based calorie and macro matching
Integrated AI chatbot powered by Grok API for instant fitness guidance
Live deployment on Vercel: fitpulse-zeta-five.vercel.app

projects.title: NagarVerse – Civic & City Discovery
projects.description: Interactive urban discovery and civic engagement platform empowering citizens to explore municipal utilities, local events, and neighborhood hubs.
projects.longDescription: NagarVerse is a civic technology platform connecting citizens to their urban environment. It offers real-time local updates, civic grievance reporting, community event schedules, and geo-enabled discovery of essential city facilities and municipal public resources.
features: Interactive geolocation-enabled city exploration map
Citizen issue lodging and municipal department routing
Community notice board for local announcements and city advisories
Responsive cross-device interface with real-time sync
